name: tasklatch
description: TaskLatch prototype: controlled local browser agents with permissions, a shared allowance and verified completion.

scripts.desktop:build: mkdir -p .runtime/docker-config && test -f .runtime/docker-config/config.json || echo {} > .runtime/docker-config/config.json; DOCKER_CONFIG=$PWD/.runtime/docker-config DOCKER_HOST=unix://$HOME/.colima/tasklatch/docker.sock docker build -t tasklatch-desktop:1 docker/desktop
